purpose: What ds-command-kernel::style_document answers for the style family's wire: the publish payload, the request body per action, and every admission rule. The kernel replays this file in tests/style_document_cases.rs and ds-web replays the identical copy through the vendored WASM, so no rule can be true on one host only.
source: ds-command-kernel/docs/contracts/ds-style-document.md; the rules moved out of ds-web src/lib/api/styles.ts (buildStyleSavePayload), src/lib/layers/user-data-style.ts (mapGeometryToSeed), src/lib/components/styles/StyleCenterDialog.svelte (extractIssueMessages, extractWarningMessages) and ds-client-core::authorized::style_edit.
note: Each case is the op WITHOUT the schema wrapper; `schema` overrides the default ds.style-document/v1. `expected` is the parsed answer, or {"error": "<the exact Err string>"} when the request itself is malformed.

cases.why: A registered design_vt ref takes its target and identity from /layers.style_editors, keeps the authored zoom range and filter, and carries no project_id for a shared-class target.
Only a project-scoped target (here survey, addressed by slug) is written with the project it belongs to.
A runtime sprite id is written back as the catalog icon name, and the catalog colour it was minted with becomes the authored icon-color.
`ud/<slug>` names the shared class it lives in, so a ref /layers never registered routes itself to user_data with <slug> as the layer name.
`pd/<slug>` names the shared class it lives in, so a ref /layers never registered routes itself to project_data with <slug> as the layer name.
`gt/<slug>` names the shared class it lives in, so a ref /layers never registered routes itself to global_tile with <slug> as the layer name.
A row that exists but declares no style_target reaches the same rule, and every other field it declared is still carried.
A ref with no row and no shared-class shape fails closed with the words that name what the backend owes.

expected.error: no backend style routing for master/unknown_layer: /layers.style_editors must declare style_target plus layer_name or slug

cases.why: A style document names its MapLibre type; a bag of paint is not a style.

expected.error: a style save needs a style document with a string type

cases.why: A publish is the declared domains.styles.update operation with the payload under `data`, read under the 1 MiB bound the registry declares.
The payload is closed: a field the backend never declared is a malformed request, not something to send and hope.
Every style reference is bounded at 500 characters; the 2 MiB payload and 16 MiB input bounds are proven in-module, since a fixture both hosts parse cannot carry them.

expected.error: a style request needs a bounded style_ref

cases.why: The kernel maps a GeoJSON geometry to the one styleable seed shape — this replaces ds-web's mapGeometryToSeed and Project Work's seedGeometry. `seed_kind` names the tile kind because `kind` names the op; the wire word stays `kind`.
A shape with no styleable seed is refused by name instead of being seeded as a point.

expected.error: no styleable seed geometry for GeometryCollection

cases.why: A shared-class read is the declared domains.styles.action operation with the backend's own action word.
The client names only the logical root, the geometry and the authored document; every runtime identity is the backend's.

ds-brain's expression warnings are {path,message} issue objects; they are admitted and normalised to text, next to plain strings and the older property+issue.message shape. Native used to refuse them while the browser accepted them.

warnings: paint.line-width: clamped to the declared maximum

cases.why: The receipt must name the target that was authored; a write that landed somewhere else is not this publish.

refusal.message: style publish receipt does not match the authored target

cases.why: Every optional identity the payload declared must come back unchanged.

refusal.message: style publish receipt does not match the authored target

cases.why: `updated` is the backend's word for 'this was written'; without it there is no publication to report.

refusal.message: style publish receipt does not match the authored target

cases.why: A warning is text or a named issue object; a number is a contract slip, and the receipt is unreadable rather than half-read.
A backend refusal is reported in the backend's own words with its status and code, and error_details.issues become `path: message` strings.
A seed is the ref and canonical geometry that were asked for, a known tile kind, a real document — and nothing persisted.
The seed path never writes: a persisted seed is a different operation than the one that was asked for.
A seed for a different ref cannot seed this editor.
A found shared-class document is answered with the document itself.
An absence is an answer, not a failure: the class simply has no shared document yet.
A found document that is not there is a contract slip, never an empty style.
The family is answered unchanged: the backend owns every runtime identity in it.
Only ds-brain's work-map assembler may name a work-map family.
A family assembled for another logical root cannot render this one.
A family with no layers renders nothing; it is a contract slip, not an empty map.
Every layer in the family belongs to the one source the backend named — otherwise the client would mount a layer over data it never asked for.
The request grammar is closed: only save_payload, request and admit exist.

expected.error: invalid style document request: unknown variant `republish`, expected one of `save_payload`, `request`, `admit` at line 1 column 57
